chapterTitle: Chapter 30 Orbitals and Organic Chemistry: Pericyclic Reactions
title: Problem 30-3

pages.text: PROBLEM 30-3 trans-3,4-Dimethylcyclobutene can open by two conrotatory paths to give either (2E,4E)-2,4-hexadiene or (2Z,4Z)-2,4-hexadiene. Explain why both products are symmetry- allowed, and then account for the fact that only the 2E,4E isomer is obtained in practice.
